# LifestudioCanada Platform - Full AI Agent Context & Documentation

## About LifestudioCanada
LifestudioCanada is a monorepo-architected web and mobile platform enabling content creators to submit videos, monitor verification stages, and receive direct monetary payouts.

## Monorepo Architecture Overview
- Web Frontend: Next.js (App Router), Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion
- Backend API: Express.js, TypeScript, MongoDB, Cloudflare R2 presigned video uploads
- Mobile App: React Native, Expo, Expo Router
- Shared Contracts: `@repo/contracts` (Zod validation schemas and shared TypeScript types)
- Shared API Client: `@repo/api-client` (Fetch-based API client for Web and Mobile)

## Video Upload Workflow
1. Client requests presigned upload URL from Express API (`/api/v1/videos/upload-url`).
2. Express API signs URL for Cloudflare R2 object storage.
3. Client uploads video file directly to Cloudflare R2 via HTTP PUT (bypassing API server).
4. Video record status transitions:
   - DRAFT -> UPLOADING -> PROCESSING -> UNDER_REVIEW -> APPROVED / REJECTED -> PAID
5. Staff & Admins inspect submissions in moderation consoles.
6. Earnings are credited directly to creator balances.

## Quality & Submission Guidelines
- Resolution: Minimum 1080p (1920x1080)
- Max File Size: 500 MB
- Accepted Codecs / Extensions: MP4, MOV, WEBM
- Content Policy: Original creator content only, no copyright infringement or non-compliant content.
